small_guidance: Enable TF32 in tl.dot (allow_tf32=True) and add larger autotune configs (BLOCK_M=256/BLOCK_N=128, num_warps=8, num_stages=4) since GPT-2 GEMMs are large and TF32 typically doubles throughput on Ada. Also drop the fp32 cast — keep weights/activations in fp16/bf16 to halve memory traffic and use tensor cores effectively.
large_guidance: Redesign to use fp16/bf16 tensor-core GEMM throughout: store TritonLinear weights in half precision, cast inputs once, accumulate in fp32, and write fp16 outputs. Fuse the GELU activation inside the MLP fc GEMM epilogue and fuse bias+residual where possible. Consider a fused QKV projection (single GEMM into 3*hidden) and a fused attention kernel (flash-attention style) so the per-layer kernel count drops dramatically — the current path launches dozens of separate fp32 matmuls which dominates runtime.
